Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for target CHEMBL1075127. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical SMILES. Filter: activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation = '='. Return assay_chembl_id (from assays.chembl_id), target_type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard_type, pchembl_value. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
